name: quant-backtest
instructions:
Run a reproducible, leakage-resistant backtest with dataset/code provenance, corporate-action fixtures, deterministic replay, and an explicit PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT-RUN verdict.

Capabilities:
- apply quant backtest methods within explicit quant boundaries
- analyze run a backtest with full audit hygiene — biases, costs, out-of-sample, regime splits — and produce a verdict on whether a strategy is robust with assumptions, constraints, and failure modes
- produce and validate a quant artifact with evidence, decisions, and next steps

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/quant/quant-backtest/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Manifest and hashes are recorded, leakage/survivorship/corporate-action checks and deterministic replay are evaluated, baseline comparison is complete or explicitly not-run, and the verdict is PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT-RUN.
